Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

vēritās

vēritās, vēritātis f.

noun, third declension

reality, real life (as against imitation, appearance or opinion); truth; truthfulness

In this lexicon

  • reality

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. de Or. 3.215: in omnī rē vincit imitātiōnem vēritās (Lewis & Short); Cic. Rosc. Com. 29 (Lewis & Short)

  • truth

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 22.39.19: vēritātem labōrāre nimis saepe ajunt, exstinguī numquam; Cic. Off. 1.109: vēritātis cultōrēs, fraudis inimīcī (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • vulgus ex vēritāte pauca, ex opīniōne multa aestimat

    the crowd judges few things by reality and many by opinionCic. Rosc. Com. 29 (Lewis & Short)

    In the entry for reality

  • in omnī rē vincit imitātiōnem vēritās

    in everything the real thing beats the imitationCic. de Or. 3.215 (Lewis & Short)

    In the entry for reality

  • vēritātem labōrāre nimis saepe ajunt, exstinguī numquam

    the truth, they say, is too often in trouble, but never snuffed outLiv. 22.39.19

    In the entry for truth

  • obsequium amīcōs, vēritās odium parit

    going along with people makes friends; the truth makes enemiesTer. An. 68, quoted in Cic. Amic. 89

    whoever has once been caught in a shameful deceit is not believed even when he tells the truthPhaedr. 1.10.1–2

    In the entry for truth

  • vēritātis simplex ōrātiō est
